questions.prompt: A published application is deployed to App Service from a ZIP archive. What archive layout does the documented deployment process require?

options.text: Deployable application files at the ZIP root.
options.explanation: A surrounding parent folder can prevent the app from finding its expected files.

options.text: All application files nested inside an arbitrary extra parent directory.
options.explanation: The required root layout should not include an extra wrapping folder.

options.text: Only an empty folder named wwwroot.
options.explanation: An empty archive cannot supply the application.

options.text: Only the source repository URL stored in a text file.
options.explanation: ZIP package deployment needs the actual deployable application files.

questions.prompt: What happens when an administrator changes App Service app settings?

options.text: The settings are supplied as environment variables and the app restarts.
options.explanation: App Service applies configuration changes through its app settings mechanism.

options.text: The App Service plan changes operating system automatically.
options.explanation: Environment settings do not convert the plan OS.

options.text: A new staging slot is always created.
options.explanation: Changing app settings does not create a slot.

options.text: The application image is necessarily rebuilt and pushed to ACR.
options.explanation: Settings changes do not require a container build or image push.

questions.prompt: A web app has managed identity enabled but receives authorization failures from a protected Azure service. What should be checked?

options.text: The identity has the required role or access policy on that target service.
options.explanation: Authentication through managed identity still requires target-service authorization.

options.text: Assume enabling identity grants Contributor to every service.
options.explanation: Identity creation does not grant broad Azure access.

options.text: Change the web app display name to the service name.
options.explanation: Matching names do not grant authorization.

options.text: Increase plan workers as the only permission fix.
options.explanation: Additional workers do not change identity permissions.
